task.title: P6-094: Add a second-collection desire block so seed data can prove sum vs max
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-094. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The dev seed desires every card from exactly one collection**, so "WANTED is the cross-collection **sum**" and "WANTED is the max" are indistinguishable against it — the `/my` mutation pass could not kill a max-instead-of-sum regression, and neither will the needs/shopping specs. Add a third independently-sentinelled block to `app/src/seed.rs` (the `BULK` block's shape) that wants one card from a second collection, then assert the summed total explicitly. `build_depth`'s own doc comment (`seed.rs:128-131`) names this gap as deliberately still open. Note the trap the bulk block hit: a new block must not quietly own the cards the tree deliberately wants and holds nowhere.
